scope: Supplemental original workload fixture; frozen eight evaluation cases and previous lab are unchanged.

dataset.source: deterministic local array; no production data

environmentPlan.device: actual OS/architecture/CPU/memory recorded; host load uncontrolled
environmentPlan.cache: new browser context per run; no-store server

workload: Select first record, change page and return; retain selection
Type Record09 sequentially with15ms key delay; record feedback computation, next animation callback and final operation completion separately
Force A=Record0 slow then B=Record09; finish A after B and retain B
Slow refresh while preserving selection, input focus and visible stale rows

criteria.dom: no more than2000DOM nodes (pagination structural guard; generous diagnostic cap, not a product budget)
criteria.feedback: per-run median input-event to next animation callback <=100ms; a modest local diagnostic gate allowing6frames at60Hz, not INP or a productionSLO

profileBoundary: CDP Performance/Memory snapshots are limited observations; no FPS, memory leak, accessibility conformance, field percentile or field Core Web Vitals claim. Preserve failures; do not retune gates after observing results.
